results.corrected_extracted: Of the 379 who reported back (Table 2), 48.3% took LSD or 1P-LSD, 28.8% psilocybin, 11.1% ayahuasca, 3.2% DMT or 5-MeO-DMT, 2.6% mescaline and 6.1% another drug; of the 654 at baseline (Table 1), 74.2% were men and 32.7% (214) reported ever having had a psychiatric diagnosis.
results.note: Drug shares recomputed from counts of 379. The men and diagnosis shares are of the 654 at baseline, not the 379; Table 1's diagnosis rows sum to 595 (36.0% of those answering).

results.corrected_extracted: 10 crossover studies (2009-2018), 194 healthy volunteers (97 women) aged 18 to 45 (Methods › Subjects); a single oral MDMA dose per analysed session, 125 mg (164) or 75 mg (30), as study conditions (112 of the 164 took 125 mg in two sessions, once after a medication pretreatment; only the MDMA-alone session was analysed); dose per body weight 1.7 (SD 0.4) mg/kg, range 0.8-2.7; sessions in a quiet hospital ward with at most two participants, lying in beds, mostly listening to music.
results.note: Numbers confirmed (112 + 24 + 28 = 164; 30 at 75 mg). 'One dose' fails for 112 who took MDMA twice. Capsules were 25 or 100 mg, so the claim's 'one capsule' is also wrong.
Matches, including mean age 32 (SD 9). Analytically confirmed doses 26 to 197 micrograms (first two studies estimated from plasma AUC); 'mostly' correctly kept from Discussion 8th paragraph.

Results 2nd (mixed models) and 7th (LASSO) paragraphs as stated; 29 minus the 8 named exceptions = 21. In two studies dose was back-estimated from plasma AUC, so the dose-plasma link is partly circular.

Results 4th paragraph as stated; 7th: well-being ranked first in LASSO for good drug effect, vigilance reduction, spiritual experience and blissful state. By the text it includes anxiety-type scales; signs only in Fig. 1.

Results 5th paragraph; 7th: openness first in LASSO for mystical and positive mood, extraversion first for auditory alteration. 'Predicted no LSD effect' means no significant association, not a shown absence.
